                }

            } else if (ch == '(') {

                count = 0;

                    wordCountInPar++;
                }
                count = 0;
            } else {
                count++;
            }
            if (par == 0) {
                maxLength = max(maxLength, count);
            }
        }
        cout << maxLength << " " << wordCountInPar << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
